Description

Remote Control Mini Desktop Cleaning Truck

Features:

  • Ages 3+
  • Remote controlled
  • Desktop cleaning truck
  • Mini cleaner
  • Bottom suction
  • Vacuum mode
  • Forward/backward
  • Cleaning/drifting mode
  • Dynamic music
  • Rechargeable convenience
  • Color May Vary

Package Includes:

  • 1 x Mini Truck
  • 1 x Remote Control
  • 1 x USB Cable

About Product:

      • Remote Control Cleaning Truck: A fun and interactive mini cleaning truck designed to provide exciting remote-control play for kids aged 3 years and above.
      • Mini Desktop Cleaner: Compact and lightweight design makes it perfect for cleaning and playing on desks, tables, and other smooth surfaces.
      • Bottom Suction Technology: Features a bottom suction function that helps pick up small dust particles while moving across suitable surfaces.
      • Vacuum Cleaning Mode: Enjoy realistic cleaning action with its built-in mini vacuum-style cleaning feature.
      • Easy Forward and Backward Movement: Simple remote controls allow children to move the cleaning truck forward and backward with ease.
      • Cleaning and Drifting Modes: Switch between cleaning and drifting modes for more exciting and entertaining playtime.
      • Dynamic Music Effects: Built-in dynamic music adds fun sounds and excitement to the remote-control cleaning experience.
      • Rechargeable Mini Cleaning Truck: Convenient rechargeable design provides an easy alternative to constantly replacing batteries.
      • Interactive Educational Toy: Encourages imaginative role-play, hand-eye coordination, and basic motor skills through interactive cleaning adventures.
      • Perfect Gift for Kids Ages 3+: An entertaining and unique remote-control toy for birthdays, holidays, and special occasions.
